import unittest

from solution import partition_by_state


class PartitionByStateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_distribution_uses_state_and_preserves_bucket_order(self):
        items = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"]
        original = items[:]
        self.assertEqual(
            partition_by_state(items, 1),
            (["c", "f"], ["a", "d", "g"], ["b", "e"]),
        )
        self.assertEqual(items, original)
        self.assertEqual(
            partition_by_state(tuple(items), 5),
            (["b", "e"], ["c", "f"], ["a", "d", "g"]),
        )

    def test_deep_copies_each_occurrence_independently(self):
        shared = {"values": [1]}
        items = [shared, shared]
        buckets = partition_by_state(items, 0)
        first = buckets[0][0]
        second = buckets[1][0]
        self.assertEqual(first, shared)
        self.assertEqual(second, shared)
        self.assertIsNot(first, shared)
        self.assertIsNot(second, shared)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first["values"], second["values"])
        first["values"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(second["values"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(shared["values"], [1])

    def test_empty_returns_three_distinct_lists(self):
        result = partition_by_state([], 0)
        self.assertEqual(result, ([], [], []))
        self.assertIsInstance(result, tuple)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], result[1])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1], result[2])

    def test_large_state_uses_modulo(self):
        self.assertEqual(partition_by_state([1, 2, 3], 100), ([3], [1], [2]))

    def test_invalid_types(self):
        for items, state in (("abc", 0), ([1], True), ([1], 1.0), ([1], "1")):
            with self.subTest(items=items, state=state), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                partition_by_state(items, state)

    def test_negative_state(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            partition_by_state([], -1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
